note: How many step timeouts in a read-only PR worker step (lane-epoch, head-lag, park-holds) are held per (PR, head, step) before one pages (BH-6670). A held kill writes one STEP_HELD line and the outcome killed:slow-read, with no lane alert and no Sentry event; the row is left as it is and the next tick works the PR again. The next kill past the cap writes STEP_TIMEOUT, a warn alert and a Sentry event. Not a number reads as 2. Settings row: lane.merge-conductor.mc_step_hold_max.
